scope: Read-only CSS and matrix review; product unchanged; DISPLAY 126 unused

facts.affected: format/scope/resources select controls in both themes and source/live

css: style.css:2546 plugin-form and plugin-form-field use grid minmax(0,1fr) and min-width:0.
style.css:2567 plugin-form-control already has width:100%, box-sizing:border-box and min-width:0. Adding min-width:0 again would not address a new mechanism.
style.css:2220 narrow sidebar uses width:min(320px,calc(100% - 24px)) and 1px right border. The select's 319px measured width matches this interior, not viewport overflow.
style.css:2230 narrow sidebar slot uses overflow:auto. Generic panel and body use overflow:hidden. Very short viewport can introduce scrolling at more than one ancestor.

desktop-plugin-ui.ts focusin calls scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest'}), so per-control focus can alter scroll positions. The saved matrix screenshot follows the final button focus, not the failed select focus.
assessment: No demonstrated intrinsic select sizing or viewport overflow defect. A scrollbar/overlay or ancestor clipping affecting the right sample is a plausible mechanism, but cornerHits=false alone proves neither visual clipping nor inability to operate the control.
pendingNativeObservations: Screenshot while each failed select is focused, before focusing the next control.
elementFromPoint identity and ancestor chain at both right corners, right-center and control center.
Each ancestor's rect, clientWidth, offsetWidth, scrollWidth, clientHeight, scrollHeight, scrollLeft/Top, overflowX/Y and any clipping.
Repeat samples after pointer moves away and idle delay to distinguish transient overlay scrollbar hit behavior.
Real pointer activation at visible dropdown arrow/center, real keyboard option change, and resulting controlled field state; restore initial values afterward.
decision: Do not change shared CSS until these observations establish an actual clipped or unusable control. If a scrollbar covers the control, address the measured scroll owner/gutter instead of arbitrary select max-width or plugin-specific selectors.
